notes.title: Boralaa Demo - Update 1.01
notes.content:
After two days of the demo release, the overall feedback was good. However, some annoying bugs and mistranslations were found and this update fix them.

[h2]Fixes and Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] The tooltip of statuses and elements were fixed. They were showing "Text" and now are showing the correct description.
[*] In some cases, the game was starting in Portuguese on the 1° play. Now, after the fix, the 1° execution starts in English and will follow your language choice from it.
[*] The 3° Kirishima attack had the wrong description and was fixed. It reduces all sources damage and not only physical ones.
[/list]

Big thanks to everyone playing Boralaa! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/x3qq87QS2P]Discord[/url] to leave your feedback and hear our ideas!
